title: Manager | GCP Data Engineer | Ahmedabad | Engineering | Data Modernization & Migration
description:
**The Team**


Deloitte’s Technology \& Transformation practice can help you uncover and unlock the value buried deep inside vast amounts of data. Our global network provides strategic guidance and implementation services to help companies manage data from disparate sources and convert it into accurate, actionable information that can support fact\-driven decision\-making and generate an insight\-driven advantage. Our practice addresses the continuum of opportunities in business intelligence \& visualization, data management, performance management and next\-generation analytics and technologies, including big data, cloud, cognitive and machine learning.  



**Your work profile**


The GCP data engineer is responsible for managing client relationships and overseeing the successful delivery of programs or accounts. This role serves as the primary point of contact between the organization and its clients, ensuring alignment of goals, timelines, budgets, and expected outcomes while driving client satisfaction and business growth.

  

**Key Skills \& Competencies**

**Experience**


* 8–11 years of overall IT experience
* Minimum 5\+ years in GCP Data Engineering projects
* Proven experience in leadership roles within consulting or enterprise environments

**Technical Expertise**


* Strong hands\-on experience with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**
* Deep expertise in:
* BigQuery
* Dataflow
* Dataproc
* Pub/Sub
* Cloud Composer (Airflow)
* Cloud Storage
* Strong programming skills:
* Python
* SQL
* Strong experience in:
* Spark and distributed data processing
* ETL/ELT frameworks
* Data warehousing and data lake architectures
* Real\-time streaming data solutions
* Experience with:
* CI/CD pipelines
* DevOps practices
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred)

**Architecture \& Engineering**


* Designing scalable, cloud\-native data platforms
* Building batch and real\-time data processing systems
* Leading data migration and modernization programs (on\-prem to GCP)
* Defining data models, governance frameworks, and best practices
* Ensuring performance optimization, cost efficiency, and system reliability
* Implementing observability, monitoring, and security standards

**Delivery \& Program Management**


* Leading multiple delivery workstreams and data engineering teams
* Managing project planning, estimation, and risk mitigation
* Driving Agile/Scrum delivery execution
* Conducting architecture, design, and code reviews
* Ensuring alignment with stakeholders and timely delivery

**Team Leadership**


* Mentoring and guiding engineers and technical leads
* Supporting hiring, training, and capability development
* Building GCP data engineering competency within the practice
* Promoting innovation and modern engineering practices

**Consulting \& Client Engagement**


* Participating in pre\-sales, solutioning, and proposal development
* Leading client workshops and requirement gathering sessions
* Presenting architecture solutions and transformation roadmaps
* Acting as a trusted advisor for enterprise data transformation programs

**Preferred Skills**


* Experience with Kubernetes and Docker
* Exposure to BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
* Knowledge of data governance and security frameworks
* Familiarity with multi\-cloud environments (AWS/Azure)
  

**Preferred Qualifications**


Education – B.Tech / BE or equivalent

  

**Success Metrics**


* Successful delivery of large\-scale GCP data transformation programs
* High client satisfaction and stakeholder alignment
* Scalable, optimized, and secure data platforms
* Strong team capability building and knowledge development

title: Sr. Cloud Manager
description:
**About Dyad:** Dyad is a leading insurance technology company with over 20 years of experience delivering solutions across the property and casualty insurance ecosystem. We support carriers, MGAs, wholesalers, and agencies with platforms that streamline underwriting, policy administration, connectivity, and operations. At Dyad, we focus on enabling scalable growth through modern, product\-driven insurance technology.**Role Summary:** The Senior Cloud Manager is a senior technical leader within Dyad's Engineering \& Technology division, responsible for owning Dyad's hyperscaler cloud strategy, architecture, and execution across AWS and Azure. This role combines strategic ownership with hands\-on engineering — defining cloud architecture, identifying weaknesses in current environments, and personally leading Dyad's consolidation of resources in the cloud. Beyond the migration, the individual will establish Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices, lead infrastructure hardening initiatives, build and scale DevOps processes across engineering teams, and serve as the primary cloud authority across Engineering, Security, IT, and Product leadership.**Key ResponsibilitiesCloud Strategy, Architecture \& Migration** 

* Define and own Dyad's hyperscaler cloud strategy across AWS (primary) and Azure (secondary); establish architecture standards, reference designs, and cloud governance frameworks across engineering teams.
* Design end\-to\-end cloud architecture across compute, networking, storage, data services, identity, and security — proactively identifying architectural weaknesses, single points of failure, and scalability gaps, and leading structured remediation.
* Lead Dyad's migration from Lumen to AWS and Azure: workload discovery and classification, dependency mapping, network redesign (VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect/ExpressRoute), cutover planning, and post\-migration validation.
* Evaluate and make strategic decisions on hyperscaler services, managed offerings, and third\-party cloud tooling aligned to Dyad's long\-term product and business objectives.

**Site Reliability Engineering \& Hardening**

* Establish and lead Dyad's SRE practice — defining SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets; building observability and monitoring frameworks; leading incident management, blameless post\-mortems, and reliability improvement initiatives.
* Own Dyad's infrastructure hardening programme — implementing zero\-trust networking, least\-privilege IAM, policy\-as\-code (SCPs, Azure Policy), secrets management, encryption standards, and SOC 2\- aligned security controls.
* Conduct regular cloud security posture assessments, vulnerability reviews, and access audits; drive remediation with clear ownership and timelines

**DevOps, Platform Engineering \& Cross\-Functional Leadership** 

* Define and scale CI/CD pipeline frameworks, Terraform\-based IaC standards, and orchestration practices adopted across all engineering squads.
* Build and scale cloud engineering processes, deployment standards, on\-call frameworks, and cost governance across teams; report on cloud spend, reliability metrics, and infrastructure roadmap to Technology leadership.
* Mentor and uplift engineering and DevOps team members on cloud architecture, SRE principles, and security\-first infrastructure design; operate as the cross\-functional cloud authority across Engineering, IT, Security, and Product.

**Production Operations**

* Monitor and maintain application availability, performance, and incident response (on\-call, alerting, SLA/SLO management) for all production systems across all providers, regions, and availability zones.
* Own deployment, release management, and change control — safely shipping code to production and rolling back when needed.
* Manage infrastructure capacity, scaling, backups, and disaster recovery for the live service.
* Manage all database operations

**Global Corporate IT**

* Provide and support end\-user technology — laptops, software licensing, helpdesk, and onboarding/offboarding across all offices/regions.
* Manage internal systems and networks (email, identity/SSO, Wi\-Fi, VPN, collaboration tools) and enforce IT security policy for employees.
* Handle vendor/asset management and compliance (procurement, device inventory, access controls) across the global org.

**Required Skills \& ExperienceSkills \& Experience**

* 8\+ years of cloud engineering experience with at least 5 years of senior, hands\-on AWS expertise in production environments, including direct ownership of cloud architecture decisions and major infrastructure programmes.
* Proven experience leading large\-scale cloud migrations from legacy network and hosting environments (e.g., Lumen, colocation, or equivalent) to AWS and/or Azure, including network redesign and cutover execution.
* Expert\-level AWS architecture: EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS/Aurora, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudFront, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, CloudWatch, GuardDuty, and Security Hub.
* Solid Azure experience: Azure Networking (VNet, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway), Azure AD/Entra ID, Azure Monitor, and Azure Policy — able to design and operate Azure environments as a secondary cloud platform.
* Expert\-level Terraform; hands\-on SRE experience including SLO/SLI design, observability stack design, and incident management; strong cloud security expertise covering IAM, zero\-trust, and compliance frameworks.
* Experience building and scaling DevOps practices across multiple engineering teams, including CI/CD pipeline design, EKS/Kubernetes operations, and engineering process standardisation.
* AWS Professional certification (Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer) strongly preferred; must be available during US business hours and for on\-call coverage during critical migration and incident events.

**Professional \& Behavioral Competencies**

* Strategic and executional in equal measure — defines the cloud roadmap and personally executes the most complex parts of it; identifies architectural weaknesses with intellectual honesty and leads practical remediation.
* Cross\-functional authority and process builder — builds standards and operating rhythms that scale across teams; communicates architectural decisions, risks, and roadmaps with confidence to both technical and leadership audiences.
* Security\-first instinct, resilient under complexity, and committed to developing cloud engineering capability in the team around them.

**Website : www.dyadtech.com** 

**Address :**  Dyad Tech Pvt. Ltd (Formerly known I\-Engineering Software Pvt. Ltd.)4th Floor, President Plaza, Opp. Titanium Square, Thaltej Cross Road,S.G. Highway, Ahmedabad\-380054

Pay: ₹1,500,000\.00 \- ₹2,500,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Software Engineering Manager — Funded Development
description:
* Permanent \- Full Time
* Ahmedabad/GiftCity

We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD — the cross\-functional team accountable for delivering customer\-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The role sits at the intersection of engineering delivery and commercial commitment and is measured on how predictably the POD ships committed customer work on time, at the quality bar our clients expect, across multiple concurrent engagements.
This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code — reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems — while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD’s core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require.

  

##### **Key Responsibilities**


* **Delivery \& stakeholder ownership** — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* **Hands\-on technical leadership \& design** — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* **Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence** — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* **AI\-assisted engineering** — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* **SE \+ SQE leadership** — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* **People management \& culture** — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.
  

##### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**


**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.
* Expert\-level hands\-on proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 through C\+\+20\) — able to review and write production\-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance.
* Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high\-performance, mission\-critical, low\-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading\-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks.
* Proven track record delivering complex, customer\-committed software projects in an Agile environment — working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows — and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don’t, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.
* Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar).
* Demonstrated success as a people manager — growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations — with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers.

**Desirable Skills \& Experience**
* Prior experience leading customer\-funded, professional services, or bespoke\-delivery engineering teams in a financial\-technology context, ideally on a major OMS/EMS/trading platform with exposure to Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, or trading UI.
* Familiarity with major exchange connectivity stacks (CME, ICE, Eurex, LSE, NSE, etc.) and with vendor certification / conformance testing, plus experience with formal CR / change\-management workflows in a regulated financial environment (Jira / Confluence for delivery tracking and design documentation).
* Working knowledge of Python for tooling, automation, and test scaffolding; familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, containerisation, and cloud technologies as applied to trading\-system delivery; background in kernel\-bypass / low\-latency networking (Solarflare, Onload) or lock\-free data structures.
* Track record of driving measurable productivity gains through AI adoption in an engineering team — e.g., accelerating design, code generation, code review, test coverage, or production triage — including establishing guardrails, prompts/skills libraries, and adoption metrics.
  

##### **Benefits**


**Compensation:**


***Competitive Benefits \& Perks in India*** *We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance.*
* **Health \& Financial Security:**
	+ Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
* **Time Off \& Flexibility:**
	+ Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in\-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in\-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in\-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands\-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.
	+ 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days.
	+ One dedicated day per year for volunteering.
	+ Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development.
	+ An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years.
	+ Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal.
	+ Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents).
* **Work\-Life Support \& Resources:**
	+ Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment.
	+ Milestone anniversary bonuses.
* **Wellness \& Lifestyle Perks:**
	+ Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives.
* **Our Culture:**
	+ Forward\-thinking, culture\-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion.

Trading Technologies (www.tradingtechnologies.com) is a global capital markets platform services company providing market\-leading technology for the end\-to\-end trading operations of Tier 1 banks, brokerages, money managers, hedge funds, proprietary traders, Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), commercial hedgers, and risk managers. With its roots in listed derivatives, the Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) company delivers “multi\-X” solutions, with “X” representing asset classes, functions, workflows, and geographies. This multi\-X approach features trade execution services across futures and options, fixed income, foreign exchange (FX), and cryptocurrencies, augmented by solutions for data and analytics, including transaction cost analysis (TCA); quantitative trading; compliance and trade surveillance; clearing and post\-trade allocation; and infrastructure services. The award\-winning TT platform ecosystem also helps exchanges deliver innovative solutions to their market participants and technology companies to distribute their complementary offerings to Trading Technologies’ clients.
Trading Technologies is backed by leading global investment firms Thoma Bravo, one of the world’s largest and most experienced software investors, and 7Ridge, a global growth equity firm focused on technology\-enabled businesses.
This investment supports Trading Technologies’ continued focus on product innovation, platform scalability, and long\-term growth for customers and partners worldwide.

title: BIT Support Engineer
description:
**Job Title: BIT Support Engineer** 

**Location: Ahmedabad**

**Experience: 5–10 Years**

**Employment Type: Full\-Time** 

Role Overview

We are looking for a skilled BIT Support Engineer (L2/L3\) to manage and support our enterprise IT infrastructure, networks, and cloud environments. The role involves handling critical incidents, ensuring high system availability, and acting as an escalation point for complex technical issues in a 24x7 operational setup.

Key Responsibilities

* Monitor and manage IT infrastructure using 24x7 monitoring tools
* Act as L2/L3 escalation point for complex incidents (P1/P2\) and perform root cause analysis (RCA)
* Administer and support Windows/Linux servers and enterprise applications
* Configure and manage network devices (routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs)
* Manage Next\-Generation Firewalls (NGFW) including policies, failover, and performance tuning
* Support data center operations including servers, SAN storage, and virtualization platforms
* Administer VMware/ESXi environments (VM provisioning, snapshots, cluster health)
* Manage and support cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Handle Microsoft 365 ecosystem (Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Azure AD, MFA)
* Ensure infrastructure security using antivirus, EDR tools, and security best practices
* Lead or support IT infrastructure projects (migrations, upgrades, deployments)
* Maintain SOPs, documentation, DR plans, and knowledge base
* Coordinate with vendors/TAMs for issue resolution and hardware/software support
* Mentor and guide junior engineers and improve team performance
* Ensure compliance with IT security standards and regulatory requirements

Required Skills \& Expertise

Technical Skills

* Strong experience in L2/L3 Support \& Incident Management (ITIL framework)
* Hands\-on experience with:
* Windows Server \& Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu)
* Networking (LAN/WAN, VPN, Routers, Switches)
* Firewalls (NGFW – Palo Alto, Fortinet, etc.)
* Virtualization (VMware/ESXi)
* Cloud Platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP)
* Microsoft 365 (Exchange, SharePoint, Azure AD)
* Knowledge of SAN Storage \& Data Center operations
* Familiarity with security tools (EDR, Antivirus) and compliance standards (ISO, PCI, GDPR)

Educational Qualification

* Bachelor’s Degree / Diploma in IT, Electronics, or related field
* Relevant certifications preferred:
* CCNA / CCNP
* Microsoft Certified
* AWS / Azure / Cloud certifications

Soft Skills

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities
* Ability to handle high\-pressure situations (critical outages)
* Good communication \& stakeholder management skills
* Ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
* Team player with mentoring capabilities

**Note that the candidate would be required to work in rotational shift(morning, night and general).**

Work Location: In person
